overall_goal: Add the spring greens to the curry, stir well, and simmer for five minutes.

goals.description: Add spring greens to the pan, stir them in, and cover to cook.
goals.rationale: The person transfers the spring greens into the pan, starts a timer, stirs the ingredients together, and covers the pan with a lid.

goals.description: Periodically stir the curry while it simmers.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly removes the lid, stirs the curry to ensure even cooking, and replaces the lid.

goals.description: Perform the final stir of the cooked curry.
goals.rationale: The person removes the lid for the last time, drains the condensation into the pan, and gives the finished curry a final stir.
